lessons.title: आँच (ā̃c) — the heat of a flame; a flame
lessons.gloss: the heat of a flame; a flame

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Hindi for to roll out (dough), then the Hindi for to puff up.
आँच — ā̃c — "the heat of a flame; a flame".
दाल को धीमी आँच पर पकाइए। Dāl ko dhīmī ā̃c par pakāie. Cook the dal on a low flame.
Feminine.
आँच (ā̃c) is a tadbhava, inherited from Sanskrit arcis, "a flame, a ray" (CDIAL 635).
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.

lessons.title: डालना (ḍālnā) — to put in; to pour in
lessons.gloss: to put in; to pour in

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Hindi for to puff up, then the Hindi for the heat of a flame.
डालना — ḍālnā — "to put in; to pour in".
गरम तेल में थोड़ा नमक डालिए। Garam tel meṁ thoṛā namak ḍāliye. Put a little salt into the hot oil.
Past, with ने (he or she …): उसने दाल में पानी डाला, usne dāl meṁ pānī ḍālā.
डालना (ḍālnā) is a tadbhava, inherited from ḍāl, "pour, put", a form CDIAL reconstructs from its descendants (CDIAL 5545).
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.

माँ ने गरम घी में जीरा डाला। Māṁ ne garam ghī meṁ jīrā ḍālā. Mother put cumin into the hot ghee.

जीरा (jīrā) is a tadbhava, inherited from Sanskrit jīraka, "cumin" (CDIAL 5234).

lessons.title: बघारना (baghārnā) — to temper (with hot spiced oil)

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Hindi for to put in, then the Hindi for cumin.
बघारना — baghārnā — "to temper (with hot spiced oil)".
माँ ने दाल को घी और जीरे से बघारा। Māṁ ne dāl ko ghī aur jīre se baghārā. Mother tempered the dal with ghee and cumin.
Past, with ने (he or she …): उसने सब्ज़ी बघारी, usne sabzī baghārī.
बघारना (baghārnā) is a tadbhava, inherited from Sanskrit vyāghārayati, "sprinkles (with hot fat)" (CDIAL 12191). CDIAL gives the Hindi verb as "to brown onions and spices in heated oil".
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.

lessons.title: भूँजना (bhū̃jnā) — to roast; to parch (dry, in a pan)
lessons.gloss: to roast; to parch (dry, in a pan)

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Hindi for cumin, then the Hindi for to temper (with hot spiced oil).
भूँजना — bhū̃jnā — "to roast; to parch (dry, in a pan)".
दादी कड़ाही में मूँगफली भूँज रही हैं। Dādī kaṛāhī meṁ mū̃gphalī bhū̃j rahī haiṁ. Grandmother is roasting peanuts in the wok.
Past, with ने (he or she …): उसने मूँगफली भूँजी, usne mū̃gphalī bhū̃jī.
भूँजना (bhū̃jnā) is a tadbhava, inherited from bhṛñjati, "parches", a form CDIAL reconstructs from its descendants (CDIAL 9586). CDIAL gives the Hindi verb as "to parch, fry".
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.

segments.text: A stamp, a die? (ठप्पा, ṭhappā.) To file (metal or wood)? (रेतना, retnā.) To set (a stone)? (जड़ना, jaṛnā.) To polish, to make shine? (चमकाना, camkānā.) To melt (something)? (पिघलाना, pighlānā.) Loose? (ढीला, ḍhīlā.) A screw? (पेंच, peñc.) A screwdriver? (पेचकस, peckas.) To tighten? (कसना, kasnā.) To rattle? (खड़खड़ाना, khaṛkhaṛānā.) To let drip? (टपकाना, ṭapkānā.) To crack, to split? (दरकना, daraknā.) A pipe? (पाइप, pāip.) A hole? (छेद, ched.) To trickle down? (ढलकना, ḍhalaknā.) A brick? (ईंट, ī̃ṭ.) Lime (for whitewash)? (चूना, cūnā.) Plaster (on a wall)? (पलस्तर, palastar.) To smear (a floor or wall with mud)? (लीपना, līpnā.) To lay (bricks)? (चिनना, cinnā.) A wire? (तार, tār.) A light bulb? (बल्ब, balb.) A switch? (स्विच, svic.) A peg? (खूँटी, khū̃ṭī.) To hang up? (टाँगना, ṭā̃gnā.) A trunk? (संदूक़, sandūq.) A spider? (मकड़ी, makṛī.) Waste paper? (रद्दी, raddī.) To sweep (with a broom)? (बुहारना, buhārnā.) To scour (pots)? (माँजना, mā̃jnā.) To kindle? (सुलगाना, sulgānā.) To knead? (गूँधना, gū̃dhnā.) A round board for rolling dough? (चकला, caklā.) To roll out (dough)? (बेलना, belnā.) To puff up? (फूलना, phūlnā.) The heat of a flame? (आँच, ā̃c.) To put in? (डालना, ḍālnā.) Cumin? (जीरा, jīrā.) To temper (with hot spiced oil)? (बघारना, baghārnā.) To roast? (भूँजना, bhū̃jnā.)
